words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He tries to flag down a taxi on the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在繁忙的街道上拦下一辆出租车。
words.en: To signal to a vehicle, especially a taxi or bus, to stop by waving one's hand or an object.

words.ex: The thieves robbed the bank last night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚抢劫了银行。
words.en: To rob someone or somewhere means to take money or property illegally from them, often using force.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.ex: He is an addict who cannot stop smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他是个无法戒烟的瘾君子。
words.en: An addict is someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or someone who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it.

words.ex: The murderer was caught by the police.
words.ex_cn: 杀人犯被警察抓住了。
words.en: A murderer is a person who has committed the crime of murder.

words.ex: The rapist was sentenced to life imprisonment.
words.ex_cn: 这名强奸犯被判处无期徒刑。
words.en: A rapist is a person who commits rape, which is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with them against their will.

words.tr: n. 武力劫夺汽车；抢劫司机财物（carjacking 的变形）
words.ex: The carjacker stole the car with a gun.
words.ex_cn: 劫车者用枪抢走了那辆车。
words.en: A carjacker is someone who steals a car by force, often while the owner or driver is still in it.

words.tr:
v. 潜伏；隐藏
n. 潜伏；埋伏
words.ex: A cat lurks behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 一只猫躲在灌木丛后。
words.en: To lurk means to wait or move in a secretive way so that you cannot be seen, especially because you are about to attack someone or do something wrong.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 搭便车的旅行者，顺便插入的广告，短篇广告
words.ex: The hitchhiker waved his hand by the roadside, hoping for a ride.
words.ex_cn: 搭便车的人在路边挥手，希望搭到车。
words.en: A hitchhiker is a person who travels by getting free rides from passing vehicles.

words.tr: adj. 搁浅的；处于困境的； v. 使搁浅；“strand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boat was stranded on the sandbank.
words.ex_cn: 船搁浅在沙洲上。
words.en: Left in a difficult or helpless situation, especially without means of escape or assistance.

words.ex: He eats as much as I do.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和我一样多。
words.en: to the same degree or extent

words.tr: n. 加速器；油门；促进剂
words.ex: He pressed the accelerator to speed up the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下油门让车加速。
words.en: An accelerator is a device in a vehicle that you press with your foot to make the vehicle go faster.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The village has a quaint old church.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一座古色古香的古老教堂。
words.en: Something that is quaint is attractive because it is unusual and old-fashioned.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖某人；依靠某人；指望某人
words.ex: I rely on my brother to help me with homework.
words.ex_cn: 我依赖我哥哥帮我做作业。
words.en: To depend on someone with full trust and confidence for support or help.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖某人；依靠某人；信赖某人
words.ex: I rely upon my brother to help me with homework.
words.ex_cn: 我依靠我哥哥帮我做作业。
words.en: To depend on someone with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖某事；依靠某物；信赖某事
words.ex: He relies upon his calculator for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠计算器来解决数学问题。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖某人以获取…；依靠某人提供…
words.ex: I rely on my brother for help with math.
words.ex_cn: 我靠我哥哥帮我解决数学问题。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖某人以获得；依靠某人提供
words.ex: I rely upon my brother for help with math.
words.ex_cn: 我依靠我哥哥帮我解决数学问题。
words.en: To depend on someone for something.

words.ex: He relies upon his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖他的兄弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.ex: He solely depends on his bike to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他只靠自行车去上班。
words.en: If something is solely the case, it is the only thing that is the case.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.tr:
v. 密谋；激起…的兴趣
n. 阴谋诡计；密谋策划
words.ex: They intrigue to take over the company.
words.ex_cn: 他们密谋接管这家公司。
words.en: If something intrigues you, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: He made a gamble on the horse race.
words.ex_cn: 他在这场赛马上赌了一把。
words.en: If you gamble on something, you take a risky action or decision in the hope of gaining something.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险一试；孤注一掷
words.ex: He decided to take a gamble and invest in the startup.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险一试，投资这家初创公司。
words.en: To take a risk in the hope of gaining an advantage or a benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险尝试某事；在某事上赌一把
words.ex: He took a gamble on the new business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险投资了这个新生意。
words.en: To take a risk by doing something that might result in loss or failure.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 信念的飞跃；凭信心的一跃；指在没有充分证据的情况下仍选择相信或行动的决策
words.ex: He took a leap of faith and started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他鼓起勇气，创办了自己的公司。
words.en: A leap of faith is an act of believing in or attempting something whose existence or outcome cannot be proved or known.

words.tr: adj. 无现金的；无现款的；不用现金的
words.ex: He pays with his phone in a cashless store.
words.ex_cn: 他在无现金商店用手机付款。
words.en: A cashless system or society is one in which people do not use cash for transactions, but instead use electronic methods such as credit cards or mobile payments.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The workers used a hoist to lift the heavy beams.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用吊升机械吊起沉重的梁。
words.en: To hoist something means to lift or pull it up to a higher position, usually using some kind of equipment such as a crane or pulley.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: The rain wiped the windshield clean.
words.ex_cn: 雨水把挡风玻璃冲干净了。
words.en: The windshield is the window at the front of a vehicle, through which the driver and passengers can see the road ahead.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.tr:
v. 钩住；拴住；急拉；搭便车
n. 故障；障碍；勾住；急拉
words.ex: The hook hitched the rope to the tree.
words.ex_cn: 钩子钩住了系在树上的绳子。
words.en: If you hitch, or hitch a ride, you hitchhike. If you hitch something to something else, you fasten it there.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: The cowboy rode his horse across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马穿过沙漠。
words.en: A cowboy is a man who herds cattle, traditionally in the western United States, and is often depicted as wearing a wide-brimmed hat and boots.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相反；与…相矛盾；违背
words.ex: His actions run contrary to his stated beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为与他的公开信仰相悖。
words.en: To be in opposition or conflict with something.

words.tr: n. 轿子；小轿车；厢式轿车
words.ex: The man rode in a sedan carried by two servants.
words.ex_cn: 这个人坐在两个仆人抬的轿子里。
words.en: A sedan is a type of car that has a closed body and a separate trunk, typically seating four or more people.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He risked his life to save the boy from the river.
words.ex_cn: 他冒着生命危险从河里救出了那个男孩。
words.en: To risk one's life means to do something that could result in one's death.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: He tried unsuccessfully to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他试图打开门，但没有成功。
words.en: In a manner that does not achieve the desired outcome or success.

words.tr: n. 卡车司机；卡车运输者
words.ex: The trucker drives across the country every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位卡车司机每周都开车穿越全国。
words.en: A trucker is someone who drives a truck as their job.

words.tr: phrase. （把车）靠边停下；靠边停车
words.ex: The police told him to pull over.
words.ex_cn: 警察让他靠边停车。
words.en: To move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop, especially when instructed by the police.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.tr:
v. 打滑；侧滑
n. 打滑；侧滑
words.ex: The car skid on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑的路面上打滑了。
words.en: If a vehicle skids, it slides sideways or forwards while moving, usually because of bad weather conditions or because the driver is going too fast.

words.tr: phrase. 在刀尖下；被刀指着（通常指处于威胁或胁迫之下）
words.ex: The robber took her wallet at knifepoint.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪用刀逼她交出钱包。
words.en: Under the threat of a knife, typically in a situation where someone is being forced to do something.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: The middle-aged man walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位中年男子每天早上遛狗。
words.en: Middle-aged refers to someone who is in the middle of their life, typically between the ages of about 45 and 65.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campground.
words.ex_cn: 我们在露营地搭起了帐篷。
words.en: A campground is a place where people can camp, typically in tents or recreational vehicles.

words.tr: n. 寄宿处； v. “lodge”的现在分词；
words.ex: He found cheap lodging near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 他在火车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。
words.en: Lodging refers to a place to live or stay, especially temporarily.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.tr: n. 护林员；公园看管人；突击队员；
words.ex: The ranger walked through the forest to check for fires.
words.ex_cn: 护林员在森林里巡逻，检查是否有火灾。
words.en: A ranger is someone whose job is to look after a forest or a large park.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.ex: He baked bread with graham flour.
words.ex_cn: 他用全麦面粉烤面包。
words.en: Graham refers to something made from or containing whole wheat flour, especially in the context of bread or crackers.

words.tr: n. 薄脆饼干；爆竹；迷人的姑娘；黑客
words.ex: He ate a cracker with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块饼干配奶酪。
words.en: A cracker is a thin, crisp biscuit which is often eaten with cheese, or a person who is very good at something, especially solving problems or puzzles.

words.ex: He drank a bottle of soda after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后喝了一瓶苏打。
words.en: A type of drink that contains bubbles of gas and is often sweet.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；翻找；乱翻
n. 翻箱倒柜的寻找
words.ex: He rummaged through his drawer to find the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他翻找抽屉找钥匙。
words.en: If you rummage through something, you search for something you want by moving things around in a careless or hurried way.

words.tr: adj. 庞大的；肥大的；体积大的；
words.ex: The box is too bulky to fit in the car.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子太大了，放不进车里。
words.en: Something that is bulky is large and heavy, and therefore difficult to move or carry.

words.tr: adj. 军队风格的；军事化的
words.ex: He wakes up at 5 a.m. for army-style training.
words.ex_cn: 他早上五点起床进行军队式训练。
words.en: Pertaining to the manner or style associated with the army.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.ex: He works at a lumber-mill near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林附近的锯木厂工作。
words.en: A lumber-mill is a factory where logs are cut into lumber.

words.ex: The old house looked dilapidated after years of neglect.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子因多年疏于维护而显得残破。
words.en: A building that is dilapidated is old and in a generally bad condition.

words.ex: He reads the bible every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读《圣经》。
words.en: The Bible is the holy book of Christianity, consisting of the Old Testament and the New Testament.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.tr:
n. 杂乱；混乱
v. 弄乱
words.ex: The table is full of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上堆满了杂物。
words.en: If things or people clutter a place, they fill it in an untidy way.

words.tr: 短语动词. 快进来吧；请进（表示热情邀请或鼓励某人进入某个地方）
words.ex: Come on in, the door is open.
words.ex_cn: 进来吧，门是开着的。
words.en: An invitation or encouragement to enter a place.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 罐焖烤肉；用锅炖的整块牛肉
words.ex: She made a delicious pot roast for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她为晚餐做了一道美味的炖牛肉。
words.en: A pot roast is a piece of beef that is cooked slowly in liquid in a covered pot.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.tr: n．七年级学生：在美国、加拿大等国家的教育体系中，指上初中一年级（7年级）的学生。
words.ex: The seventh-grader solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 七年级学生很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: A seventh-grader is a student who is in the seventh grade of school.

words.tr: v. 搭便车旅游；沿途搭乘别人车旅行
words.ex: He wants to hitchhike across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他想搭便车横跨全国。
words.en: To travel by getting free rides from passing vehicles.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.tr: adj. 有礼貌的；行为端正的；文雅的
words.ex: The well-mannered boy said thank you to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 这个有礼貌的男孩对老师说了谢谢。
words.en: Someone who is well-mannered is polite and has good manners.

words.tr: adj. 注意的；专心的；留心的；关心的
words.ex: The child is attentive in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子上课很专心。
words.en: If you are attentive, you are paying close attention to what is being said or done.

words.ex: He waved a patriotic flag during the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面爱国的旗帜。
words.en: If someone is patriotic, they feel love, loyalty, and respect for their country.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助某人解决问题或摆脱困境
words.ex: He helped me out with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮我解决了作业问题。
words.en: to assist someone in a difficult situation or to provide what is necessary to accomplish something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 心里想着……；打算……；考虑……
words.ex: Do you have anyone in mind for the job?
words.ex_cn: 你心里有合适的人选吗？
words.en: If you have something in mind, you are thinking about it as a possibility or as a plan.

words.ex: His pessimism made him expect the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲观主义让他总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: Pessimism is the belief that bad things are going to happen or that something is going to turn out badly.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The inverse order of the numbers is 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的倒序是5、4、3、2、1。
words.en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

words.ex: The story shows a cause-and-effect relationship between rain and flooding.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事展示了降雨和洪水之间的因果关系。
words.en: The principle that everything has a reason or cause that leads to a particular effect.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr: 短语：从一个……的角度/位置/方面看待某事物
words.ex: He views the problem from a different angle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个不同的角度看待这个问题。
words.en: To consider or assess something from a particular perspective or angle.

words.tr: phrase. 从一个……的角度看待某人
words.ex: He views her from a different angle.
words.ex_cn: 他从不同的角度看待她。
words.en: To consider or assess someone from a particular perspective or angle.

words.tr:
n. 绝望；
v. 绝望；
words.ex: He felt despair after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到绝望。
words.en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 滑倒；悄悄溜走；不经意间犯错
words.ex: He slipped over on the wet floor.
words.ex_cn: 他在湿的地板上滑倒了。
words.en: To move smoothly and quietly in a particular direction, often without being noticed.

words.ex: He lives alone by choice.
words.ex_cn: 他独自生活是出于自己的选择。
words.en: If you do something by choice, you do it because you want to do it and not because you are forced to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.tr: phrase. 经历…而幸存；度过（艰难时期）；经受住
words.ex: He lived through a big storm last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一场大风暴。
words.en: To experience and survive a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.w: When all is said and done
words.tr: phrase. 最终；归根结底；说到底
words.ex: When all is said and done, he still loves his family.
words.ex_cn: 归根结底，他仍然爱他的家人。
words.en: used to say what the most important thing is after everything has been considered

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: He likes coffee; conversely, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡；相反，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: In a way that is the opposite or reverse of something else.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为食；靠…生存；吞噬
words.ex: The wolf feeds upon rabbits.
words.ex_cn: 狼以兔子为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or use something as a source of energy.

words.ex: The old woman made a prophecy about the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言了会有雨。
words.en: A prophecy is a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magical powers.

words.ex: He believed he would fail, and so he did — it was a self-fulfilling prophecy.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己会失败，结果真的失败了——这就是一个自我实现的预言。
words.en: A self-fulfilling prophecy is a prediction that directly or indirectly causes itself to become true, by the very terms of the prophecy itself, due to positive feedback between belief and behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 服务站；加油站（尤指提供汽车加油、维修等服务的场所）
words.ex: He stopped at the service station to fill his car with gas.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A service station is a place beside a motorway where you can buy petrol, oil, and other things for your car, and sometimes also food and drink.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.ex: He stopped at the gas station to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A gas station is a place where fuel is sold for motor vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: He has hepatitis and needs to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他患有肝炎，需要休息。
words.en: Hepatitis is an inflammation of the liver, often caused by a viral infection.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr: n. 否定论，消极论，反对癖性
words.ex: His negativism makes it hard to cheer him up.
words.ex_cn: 他的消极态度让他很难被鼓舞。
words.en: A tendency to be negative in attitude or outlook; skepticism.

words.ex: He gave her a loud affirmation.
words.ex_cn: 他给了她一个大声的肯定。
words.en: An affirmation is a statement or sign that something is true.

words.ex: I am thankful for my friend's help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激朋友的帮助。
words.en: If you are thankful for something, you are pleased and grateful for it.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: He is a solver of hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位解决难题的人。
words.en: A solver is a person or thing that solves a problem or puzzle.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr: phrase. 在…方面；就…而言；从…角度
words.ex: He is good in terms of math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学能力方面很出色。
words.en: You use in terms of to indicate the aspect or subject that you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: Mankind needs to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护环境。
words.en: Human beings considered collectively; the human race.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: He gave a constructive comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 他对我的论文给出了建设性的评论。
words.en: If something is constructive, it is useful and intended to help or improve something.

words.tr: phrase. 关心的；有关的；涉及……的
words.ex: She is concerned with her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她关心她儿子的健康。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are interested in it or involved in it.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: He walked through the shadowland at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 他在黄昏时穿过影子之地。
words.en: A shadowland is a place or situation that is unclear or uncertain, often because it exists between two very different states or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 许多（后接单数可数名词，表示复数意义）；一个又一个的
words.ex: Many a student fails this test.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生都未能通过这次考试。
words.en: Used to indicate a large number of something, followed by a singular noun.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: He is a freelance graphic designer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由职业的平面设计师。
words.en: A freelance person is someone who does particular pieces of work for different organizations, rather than working all the time for a single organization.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: phrase. 使经受考验；对…进行检验；验证
words.ex: They put the new machine to the test.
words.ex_cn: 他们对新机器进行了测试。
words.en: To subject something or someone to a test to evaluate their performance, quality, or reliability.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The siren sounded loudly as the fire truck rushed by.
words.ex_cn: 消防车疾驰而过时，警报器发出了响亮的声音。
words.en: A siren is a device that makes a loud prolonged sound as a signal or warning. It can also refer to a woman who is considered to be alluring or fascinating but also dangerous.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.tr: phrase. 作为兼职；另外；暗地里
words.ex: He works as a teacher and drives a taxi on the side.
words.ex_cn: 他当老师，同时兼职开出租车。
words.en: If someone does something on the side, they do it in addition to their main job.

words.tr: adj. 固执的；死心眼儿的
words.ex: He is bullheaded and refuses to listen.
words.ex_cn: 他很固执，拒绝听别人的意见。
words.en: If you describe someone as bullheaded, you mean they are determined to do what they want to do and refuse to change their mind, even when other people think they are being unreasonable.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持到底；忍受困境直到结束
words.ex: He decided to stick it out until the end.
words.ex_cn: 他决定坚持到最后一刻。
words.en: To continue doing something difficult or unpleasant until it is finished.

words.ex: We ate dinner, and afterward we watched a movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，之后看了部电影。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr: n. 板条箱；箱子；篓；破旧的飞机或汽车；
words.ex: The apples were packed in a wooden crate.
words.ex_cn: 苹果被装在一个木板条箱里。
words.en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing goods.

words.tr: n. 沙丁鱼；沙丁鱼罐头
words.ex: He ate a sardine for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一条沙丁鱼。
words.en: A small fish that is often canned and eaten as food.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.tr: phrase. 突然投入；贸然开始；一头扎进；果断参与
words.ex: He plunged in without waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他没等就跳了进去。
words.en: To start doing something suddenly and energetically, often without stopping to think.

words.tr: phrase. 使突然陷入；投身于；跳入；投入（某活动或状态）
words.ex: He likes to plunge into cold water in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天跳进冷水里。
words.en: To start to do something suddenly and with a lot of energy, often without thinking about it first.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He crumpled the paper in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他把纸揉皱了。
words.en: If you crumple something such as paper or cloth, or if it crumples, it is squashed and becomes full of untidy creases and folds.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread from the grocer.
words.ex_cn: 他从杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocer is a person who sells food and small household goods.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.tr: 传闻说：表示某种消息或信息是通过传闻得知的，尚未证实。
words.ex: Rumour has it that he quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 据说他辞职了。
words.en: It is said or believed by many people, though not necessarily confirmed.

words.ex: Rumor has it that he quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 据说他辞职了。
words.en: It is said or rumored that something is the case.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 给汤里加一点盐。
words.en: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly. A dash is a straight, horizontal line used in writing, for example to separate two main clauses whose meanings are closely connected.

words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.tr: phrase. 作出牺牲；付出代价；舍弃个人利益以达成目标
words.ex: They make sacrifices to save money for their children's education.
words.ex_cn: 他们做出牺牲，为孩子的教育存钱。
words.en: To give up something valued for the sake of other considerations.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.tr:
v. 使目眩；使眼花；使惊叹
n. 耀眼；眩惑；灿烂
words.ex: The stars dazzle at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的星星闪耀夺目。
words.en: If something dazzles you, it is so bright that you cannot see properly for a short time. It can also mean to greatly impress someone.

words.tr: n. 舞台灯光；公众注意的中心
words.ex: He loves to be in the limelight.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点。
words.en: The focus of public attention or notoriety.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.tr: phrase. 电视迷你剧；电视短剧
words.ex: He watched a tv mini-series about pirates.
words.ex_cn: 他看了一部关于海盗的电视迷你剧。
words.en: A television mini-series is a short series of television episodes that tell a single story or cover a specific theme, typically broadcast over a few days or weeks.

words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上；从一个角度来看
words.ex: In one sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: From one particular point of view or interpretation.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.ex: The iron fence will corrode in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 铁栅栏在雨中会生锈。
words.en: If metal or stone corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.tr: phrase. 涌入；大量涌入（指人、信息、事物等迅速大量地进入某处）
words.ex: The river overflowed and caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 河水泛滥，导致村庄发生洪水。
words.en: To come or go somewhere in very large numbers or amounts.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr: phrase. 被迫做某事；感到有压力去做某事
words.ex: He is pressed to finish the homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他被催着在晚饭前做完作业。
words.en: To be compelled or find it difficult to do something, often because of time constraints or lack of resources.

words.w: be hard pressed to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 很难做某事；几乎无法做到某事
words.uk: biː hɑːd ˈprest tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: biː hɑːrd ˈprest tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He is hard pressed to finish the work on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很难按时完成这项工作。
words.en: If you say that you are hard pressed to do something, you mean that you find it very difficult to do.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持到底；不改变原定计划或方向
words.ex: He decided to stay the course even when it was hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他还是决定坚持到底。
words.en: To continue with a process or effort, despite difficulties or challenges.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.tr: 习语. 说实话；坦白讲
words.ex: Truth be told, I did not like the movie.
words.ex_cn: 说实话，我不喜欢这部电影。
words.en: Used to indicate that one is about to be honest or to reveal the truth.

words.ex: He drew a dot on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小圆点。
words.en: A dot is a very small round mark, for example one that is used as the top part of the letter 'i', as a full stop, or as a decimal point.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr: n. 不速之客; 偶尔的来访; 旁听生; 吸毒者的巢穴 adj. 可随时造访的; 无须预约的 ; 免
words.ex: You can make a drop-in visit to the library anytime.
words.ex_cn: 你可以随时去图书馆做个临时访问。
words.en: A drop-in is someone who visits a place without having arranged to do so beforehand, or a place where people can go without an appointment.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.ex: He is an unwed father.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个未婚的父亲。
words.en: Someone who is unwed has never been married.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人提供住宿；留宿某人
words.ex: They put me up for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他们让我留宿了一晚。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to nominate someone for a position or role; to lift or raise something.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr: v. 发慈悲；动怜悯心；缓和
words.ex: The teacher finally relented and gave the students more time.
words.ex_cn: 老师终于发慈悲，给了学生们更多时间。
words.en: If you relent, you allow someone to do something that you had previously refused to allow them to do.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必不可少的； v. 需要；要求；“require”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Water is required for survival.
words.ex_cn: 水是生存所必需的。
words.en: Necessary according to the rules or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现；意外闯入；无意中陷入（某种情况或地方）
words.ex: He stumbled into the room with a big smile.
words.ex_cn: 他笑着跌跌撞撞地走进了房间。
words.en: To enter a place or situation by chance or without intending to.

words.ex: The painting is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是无价的。
words.en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money, or that it is very important to you and you could not replace it.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.tr: n. 手写书法；手写字体
words.ex: He practices hand-calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习手写书法。
words.en: The art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.tr: n. 衬线体; 衬线，截线（衬线指的是字体起始末端的细节装饰）
words.ex: The book uses a serif font for the text.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的正文使用了衬线字体。
words.en: A serif is a small line or stroke regularly attached to the end of a larger stroke in a letter or symbol within a particular font or family of fonts.

words.tr: n. （印刷）无衬线字体（同 sans serif）
words.ex: The font is sans-serif and easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 这种字体是无衬线字体，易于阅读。
words.en: Sans-serif refers to a typeface that does not have the small projecting features called 'serifs' at the end of strokes.

words.ex: He chose a clean typeface for his poster.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的海报选择了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: The design of a set of characters in a particular style and size, used in printing or on a computer screen.

words.tr: n. 印刷术；排印；印刷样式
words.ex: He loves good typography in books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢书中的好排版。
words.en: The art or process of setting and arranging types and printing from them.

words.tr: adv. 在艺术上地；有艺术地
words.ex: She paints artistically with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 她用鲜艳的颜色艺术地绘画。
words.en: In a way that relates to art or artists; with skill and imagination in creating something.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The amount of sugar is proportionally increased with the amount of flour.
words.ex_cn: 糖的量随着面粉的量成比例增加。
words.en: In a way that corresponds in size or amount to something else.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: The document uses a clean font.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档使用了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: A font is a set of printable or displayable text characters in a specific style and size.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The two roads diverge after the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在桥后分岔。
words.en: If one thing diverges from another similar thing, the first thing becomes different from the second or develops differently from it. You can also say that two things diverge.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

words.ex: The board of directors made a new decision.
words.ex_cn: 董事会做出了一个新决定。
words.en: A board of directors is a group of people elected by the shareholders of a company to manage the company's affairs.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.tr: phrase. v. （指突然意识到某事）逐渐被明白，开始理解
words.ex: It dawned on him that he forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他突然意识到自己忘了钥匙。
words.en: If a fact dawns on you, you realize it gradually.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指突然）被理解，被意识到，逐渐明白
words.ex: It finally dawned upon him that he had forgotten her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己忘了她的生日。
words.en: If a fact dawns on you, you realize it after a period of not being aware of it.

words.tr: phrase. 重新开始；从头再来
words.ex: He decides to start over after failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后决定从头再来。
words.en: To begin again or anew.

words.tr: n. 沉重，重量; 可称性
words.ex: The heaviness of the box made it hard to carry.
words.ex_cn: 箱子的沉重让它很难搬动。
words.en: The quality or state of being heavy in weight.

words.ex: The lightness of the box made it easy to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的轻便让它很容易携带。
words.en: The quality of being light in weight or not heavy; the quality of being cheerful and carefree.

words.ex: The movie is computer-animated.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是电脑动画制作的。
words.en: Produced by the use of computer animation techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 故事片；长片电影（通常指时长超过一定标准的虚构类电影）
words.ex: He wants to make a feature film next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年拍一部故事片。
words.en: A feature film is a film with a running time long enough to be considered the principal or sole film to fill a program.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.tr: phrase. 失去信心；失去信念；不再相信
words.ex: He lost faith in his friend after the lie.
words.ex_cn: 在那个谎言之后，他失去了对朋友的信任。
words.en: To stop believing in someone or something; to stop having trust or confidence in someone or something.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumor is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumors, something disrupts this cycle. Tumor cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumor continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.ex: The pancreas makes insulin to control blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: The pancreas is a large gland behind the stomach which secretes digestive enzymes into the duodenum. Embedded in the pancreas are the islets of Langerhans, which secrete into the blood the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.tr:
adj. 不能治愈的；无可救药的
n. 患不治之症者；不能治愈的人
words.ex: The disease is incurable.
words.ex_cn: 这种病无法治愈。
words.en: If someone has an incurable disease, they cannot be cured of it.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He has pancreatic cancer.
words.ex_cn: 他患有胰腺癌。
words.en: Relating to the pancreas, a large gland behind the stomach that secretes digestive enzymes and the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.tr: adj. 可医治的；可治愈的
words.ex: This disease is curable with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这种病可以通过药物治愈。
words.en: A curable disease or medical condition is one that can be cured.

words.ex: Thankfully, the rain stopped before we left.
words.ex_cn: 幸亏雨在我们出发前停了。
words.en: In a way that expresses gratitude or relief.

words.ex: He refuses to accept the dogma of the church.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝接受教会的教条。
words.en: A principle or set of principles laid down by an authority as incontrovertibly true.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 掩盖，盖过（声音）；使…听不见
words.ex: The music was so loud it could drown out the talking.
words.ex_cn: 音乐声太大了，能把说话声盖住。
words.en: to be louder than another sound so that it cannot be heard

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.ex: He is an idealistic young man who wants to change the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个理想主义的年轻人，想要改变世界。
words.en: If you describe someone as idealistic, you mean that they have ideals, and base their behaviour on these ideals, often in a way that is not practical.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.tr: adj. 有冒险精神的；敢于创新的；
words.ex: He is an adventurous boy who loves climbing mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢爬山的有冒险精神的男孩。
words.en: Willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.tr: phrase. 签字批准；结束工作；正式结束（广播或节目）
words.ex: My boss has to sign off on the plan before we start.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板必须批准这个计划，我们才能开始。
words.en: To conclude a broadcast or a piece of work, especially by saying goodbye or making a final statement.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.tr:
adj. 惊险的； 令人激动的
v. 激动；震颤；兴奋；“thrill”的现在分词
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人激动。
words.en: If something is thrilling, it causes a sudden feeling of great excitement, enjoyment, or sometimes fear.

words.ex: Please specify the time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请详细说明会议的时间。
words.en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: He is confined to his room because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
words.en: If you confine something or someone, you limit them to a particular place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人开始做某事；促使某人持续进行某事
words.ex: The loud music set him dancing all night.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让他整晚都跳舞。
words.en: To cause someone to start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……情况下；在……条件下（常用于表达特定情境或条件）
words.ex: He stayed calm under difficult circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 他在困难的情况下保持了冷静。
words.en: Used to indicate the specific conditions or situation in which something happens or is true.

words.tr: phrase. 在…情况下；在…环境中
words.ex: In bad circumstances, people still try to be happy.
words.ex_cn: 在糟糕的情况下，人们仍然努力保持快乐。
words.en: Under a specific set of conditions or situations.

words.tr:
n. 凡人
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
words.ex: All mortal beings must die someday.
words.ex_cn: 所有凡人都终有一死。
words.en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live forever.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: He runs with great vigour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都充满精力地跑步。
words.en: Physical or mental strength and energy.

words.ex: His keenness to learn made him study every day.
words.ex_cn: 他学习的热忱让他每天都在学习。
words.en: The quality of being eager or enthusiastic, or the ability to perceive or understand things quickly and clearly.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天是否会下雨还没有确定。
words.en: Something that is certain is sure to happen or is definitely true.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…理所当然；想当然
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal without thinking about it.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人想象成…；把某人描绘成…；把某人视为…
words.ex: I picture him as a teacher who loves kids.
words.ex_cn: 我把他想象成一个喜欢孩子的老师。
words.en: To imagine someone in a particular role or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物想象成；把某事物描绘成
words.ex: I picture him as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我把他想象成一位老师。
words.en: To imagine or describe something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: adj. 难以置信的；不可想象的；
words.ex: The damage from the storm was unimaginable.
words.ex_cn: 风暴造成的破坏难以置信。
words.en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand because it is not part of people's normal experience.

words.tr: adv. 不断地；无穷尽地；无休止地
words.ex: He watches TV endlessly.
words.ex_cn: 他无休止地看电视。
words.en: Without end; continuing forever or indefinitely.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.ex: He felt listless after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 他生病后感到无精打采。
words.en: If someone is listless, they lack energy or enthusiasm.

words.ex: His listlessness made it hard to finish the work.
words.ex_cn: 他的无精打采让他难以完成工作。
words.en: A state of lacking energy or enthusiasm.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.tr:
adj. 幸福的；受祝福的；神圣的
v. 祝福；保佑；“bless”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She is blessed with a kind heart.
words.ex_cn: 她拥有一颗善良的心。
words.en: Made holy; consecrated.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: adv. 朦胧地; 模糊地; 有薄雾地
words.ex: He hazily remembered his childhood home.
words.ex_cn: 他模糊地记得自己的童年家园。
words.en: In a way that is not clear because of haze or mist; vaguely or indistinctly.

words.tr: phrase. 老掉牙的故事；陈词滥调
words.ex: He told the old story again to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他又把那个老故事讲给了他的孩子们听。
words.en: A situation or subject that has been discussed or experienced so often that it is no longer interesting or surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 老生常谈；陈词滥调；重复发生的老问题
words.ex: He says he lost his job again — the same old story.
words.ex_cn: 他说他又丢了工作——还是老一套。
words.en: A situation or account that is tediously familiar and often repeated.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事对某人感激的；感谢某人某事
words.ex: I am grateful to my teacher for helping me.
words.ex_cn: 我感谢老师帮助了我。
words.en: Feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness; thankful.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: The village was stricken by a sudden flood.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄遭受了一场突如其来的洪水。
words.en: If a person or place is stricken by something such as an unpleasant feeling, an illness, or a natural disaster, they are severely affected by it.

words.tr: adj. 感激的；欣赏的；表示赞赏的
words.ex: She was appreciative of his help.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的帮助心怀感激。
words.en: If you are appreciative of something, you are grateful for it.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事心存感激的；表示感谢的
words.ex: He is appreciative of his teacher's help.
words.ex_cn: 他感激老师的帮助。
words.en: To recognize the full worth of something and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: The birch trees have white bark.
words.ex_cn: 桦树有白色的树皮。
words.en: A birch is a type of tree with thin branches and a smooth trunk, which is often white or silver in color.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr: v. 唤醒；唤起；使意识到
words.ex: The loud noise awakened him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他吵醒了。
words.en: If you awaken a feeling or emotion, or if it awakens, it starts to be felt or experienced.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；令人高兴的
words.ex: The garden is delightful in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，这个花园令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is delightful is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.tr:
n. 小河；溪
v. （不）忍受；（不）容忍
words.ex: The child jumps over the brook.
words.ex_cn: 孩子跳过小溪。
words.en: A small stream; to tolerate or allow something.

words.tr:
n. 波斯人；波斯语
adj. 波斯人的；波斯语的
words.ex: He is a persian from Iran.
words.ex_cn: 他是来自伊朗的波斯人。
words.en: Relating to Persia (now Iran), its people, or their language.

words.ex: He sat on the rug near the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在壁炉旁的地毯上。
