words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover part of it and to make it warmer or softer to walk on.

words.ex: The rain was unending.
words.ex_cn: 雨下个不停。
words.en: Something that is unending seems to have no end or to last forever.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；热望
adj. 渴望的；热望的
v. 渴望；热望；“long”的现在分词
v. 用练马绳训练马的各种步态
words.ex: Her longing for home grew stronger each day.
words.ex_cn: 她对家的渴望与日俱增。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting something or someone.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.tr: n. 被面试者；被采访者；
words.ex: The interviewee answered all the questions calmly.
words.ex_cn: 被面试者冷静地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A person who is interviewed.

words.ex: More often than not, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数情况下，他走路去上学。
words.en: If you say that something happens more often than not, you mean that it happens more than half the time.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 储备的；备用的；留作后备的
words.ex: He keeps some money in reserve.
words.ex_cn: 他把一些钱留作备用。
words.en: Kept back or set aside for future use or a special purpose.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The goalkeeper stopped the ball with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 守门员用手挡住了球。
words.en: A goalkeeper is the player in a sports team whose job is to stop the ball from entering the goal.

words.ex: The striker walked out of the factory with other workers.
words.ex_cn: 这位罢工者和其他工人一起离开了工厂。
words.en: A striker is a player in a game such as football whose main purpose is to try to score goals, or a worker who refuses to work as a protest.

words.ex: The midfielder passes the ball to the striker.
words.ex_cn: 中场球员把球传给前锋。
words.en: A midfielder is a player in sports such as football or soccer who plays in the middle part of the field, often involved in both defending and attacking.

words.tr: n. 防御者；防守队员；拥护者；卫冕者
words.ex: The defender stopped the ball with his foot.
words.ex_cn: 防守球员用脚挡住了球。
words.en: A defender is someone who defends a place or person, or who supports an idea or policy.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.w: to the best of one's ability
words.tr: 短语. 尽某人最大能力；竭尽全力
words.uk: tə ðə best əv wʌnz əˈbɪləti
words.us: tu ðə best əv wʌnz əˈbɪləti
words.ex: He did the job to the best of his ability.
words.ex_cn: 他尽自己最大的能力完成了工作。
words.en: As well as one can; using all one's skills and resources.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.w: get in the way of sth.
words.tr: phrase. v. 妨碍某事；阻挡某事的进行
words.uk: ɡet ɪn ðə weɪ ɒv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɡet ɪn ðə weɪ əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: Don't let fear get in the way of your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 不要让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。
words.en: To prevent or hinder something from happening or progressing.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr: adv. 连续地；不断地；连续不断地；
words.ex: The machine works continuously without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器连续工作，不停止。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.ex: The concept of oneness is central to many spiritual beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 统一性的概念是许多精神信仰的核心。
words.en: The state or quality of being one; singleness or unity.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: phrase. v. 随大流；盲目跟从他人行动
words.ex: He buys the same phone just to follow the herd.
words.ex_cn: 他买同样的手机只是为了随大流。
words.en: To do what most other people are doing, without independent thought.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr: phrase. 根据事物本身的优点或实际情况来评价某事
words.ex: We should assess the job offer on its merits.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该根据其自身优点来评估这份工作邀请。
words.en: To evaluate something based on its own qualities or value, without considering other factors.

words.tr: phrase. 根据某事物本身（的情况）来评判它
words.ex: They judge the book on its cover.
words.ex_cn: 他们根据封面来评判这本书。
words.en: To evaluate something based on its own merits, not on external factors.

words.tr: phrase. 根据其自身情况来评估某事物；不依赖外部因素或比较地进行评价
words.ex: We must assess the book on its own.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须单独评价这本书。
words.en: To evaluate something independently, without considering other factors or influences.

words.tr: phrase. 就某事本身进行评判；单独评价某事物
words.ex: Do not judge it on its own without looking at the whole picture.
words.ex_cn: 不要只凭它本身来评判，要看整体情况。
words.en: To evaluate something based solely on its own qualities, without comparison.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.tr:
v. 断然拒绝
n. 粗暴回绝；生硬的拒绝
words.ex: He rebuffed her offer with a shake of his head.
words.ex_cn: 他摇了摇头，拒绝了她的提议。
words.en: If you rebuff someone or rebuff a suggestion that they make, you refuse to do what they suggest.

words.tr: phrase. 灰心；泄气；失去勇气
words.ex: Don't lose heart, you can try again.
words.ex_cn: 别灰心，你可以再试一次。
words.en: To become discouraged or disheartened.

words.tr: phrase. 值得赞扬的是（某人）；归功于（某人）
words.ex: To his credit, he finished the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 值得称赞的是，他按时完成了项目。
words.en: Used to say that someone deserves praise for something they have done.

words.tr: 短语. 意思是‘随便做某事’，常用于表示允许或鼓励对方自由地做某事，无拘束地采取行动
words.ex: Feel free to ask me any question.
words.ex_cn: 随时问我任何问题。
words.en: To do something without hesitation or worry.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.ex: Chances are that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很可能会下雨。
words.en: It is likely that...

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.tr: n. 投稿人；贡献者；因素；
words.ex: He is a contributor to the local newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地报纸的投稿人。
words.en: A contributor is someone who gives something, such as money, time, or ideas, to help achieve or provide something.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: 短语动词，使某人陷入某种状态或做出某种行为；迫使某人做某事
words.ex: The constant pressure from her parents drove her to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 来自父母的持续压力迫使她取得成功。
words.en: If a feeling or idea drives someone to do something, it is the reason why they do it.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.w: haul oneself up by one's bootstraps
words.tr: phrase. 凭自己的努力摆脱困境；白手起家，自力更生
words.ex: He had no help from anyone; he had to haul himself up by his bootstraps.
words.ex_cn: 他没有得到任何人的帮助；他必须靠自己努力奋斗。
words.en: To improve one's situation by one's own efforts.

words.w: pull oneself up by one's bootstraps
words.tr: phrase. 自力更生；凭一己之力摆脱困境
words.uk: pʊl wʌnˈself ʌp baɪ wʌnz ˈbuːtstræps
words.us: pʊl wʌnˈself ʌp baɪ wʌnz ˈbuːtstræps
words.ex: He pulled himself up by his bootstraps to start a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他白手起家创办了一家小企业。
words.en: To improve one's situation by one's own efforts, especially without help from others.

words.w: haul oneself up by one's own bootstraps
words.tr: phrase. 靠自己的力量摆脱困境；白手起家；自力更生
words.uk: hɔːl wʌnself ʌp baɪ wʌnz əʊn ˈbruːtˌstræps
words.us: hɔːl wʌnself ʌp baɪ wʌnz oʊn ˈbruːtˌstræps
words.ex: He hauled himself up by his own bootstraps to start a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他白手起家创办了一家小企业。
words.en: To improve one's situation by one's own efforts without external help.

words.w: pull oneself up by one's own bootstraps
words.tr: phrase. 自力更生；凭自己的力量摆脱困境
words.uk: /pʊl wʌnˈself ʌp baɪ wʌnz əʊn ˈbuːtstræps/
words.us: /pʊl wʌnˈsɛlf ʌp baɪ wʌnz oʊn ˈbutˌstræps/
words.ex: He pulled himself up by his own bootstraps to get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 他靠自己努力找到了一份更好的工作。
words.en: To improve one's situation by one's own efforts, without any help from others.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.tr: n. 引导程序; 解靴带; 靴袢; 自益
words.ex: The company managed to bootstrap its way to success without any outside investment.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在没有外部投资的情况下成功地自力更生。
words.en: To bootstrap means to start something with minimal resources, often relying on ingenuity and self-reliance.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

words.ex: She faced the challenge courageously.
words.ex_cn: 她勇敢地面对挑战。
words.en: In a way that shows bravery or courage.

words.tr: phrase. 悉心照料某人度过（疾病、困难时期）；全程看护某人直至康复或渡过难关
words.ex: She nursed her mother through a long illness.
words.ex_cn: 她照顾她母亲度过了漫长的病期。
words.en: To care for someone during a difficult period, especially an illness.

words.tr: phrase. 精心照料使…顺利度过；悉心扶持使…成功完成
words.ex: She nursed the project through its early stages of development.
words.ex_cn: 她精心培育这个项目，使其度过了早期的发展阶段。
words.en: To carefully manage or guide something through a process or difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 悉心照料某人度过（疾病或困难时期）；耐心帮助某人熬过某事
words.ex: She nursed her husband through a long and difficult illness.
words.ex_cn: 她护理丈夫度过了漫长而艰难的疾病期。
words.en: To care for someone during a difficult period, especially a period of illness.

words.tr: phrase. 精心照料使某事物度过（难关）；细心扶持某事物使其顺利经历某阶段
words.ex: He nursed his project through the final stages.
words.ex_cn: 他小心翼翼地推进他的项目到最后阶段。
words.en: To carefully manage or guide something through a difficult process or period.

words.tr: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症；
words.ex: Children must get vaccinated to prevent polio.
words.ex_cn: 儿童必须接种疫苗以预防脊髓灰质炎。
words.en: Polio, also known as poliomyelitis, is a highly infectious viral disease that mainly affects young children. The virus is transmitted by person-to-person spread mainly through the fecal-oral route or, less frequently, by a common vehicle (e.g., contaminated water or food) and multiplies in the intestine, from where it can invade the nervous system and can cause paralysis.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.tr: phrase. 选择某人担任某职务或参与某事
words.ex: The committee selected him to be the new chairman.
words.ex_cn: 委员会选择他担任新主席。
words.en: To choose someone to do a particular job or task.

words.tr: n. 总统职位；总统任期
words.ex: He won the presidency in 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他在2020年赢得了总统职位。
words.en: The position or term of office of a president.

words.tr: phrase. 在…深处；在…最深处；在…最严峻/最黑暗的时刻
words.ex: He found peace in the depth of the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林深处找到了宁静。
words.en: In the most extreme or intense part of something, especially a period of time or a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 在…深处；处于…最严峻的时刻；深陷于（某种强烈情绪或困境）
words.ex: He found the old letter in the depths of the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在抽屉的深处找到了那封旧信。
words.en: In the most extreme or severe part of a situation or place.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The spokesperson spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesperson is a person who speaks officially for a group or an organization.

words.ex: The limitation of the phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的限制是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A limitation is a rule or situation that restricts what you can do or what can happen.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.tr: n. 自我控制；克己； 自控力
words.ex: He showed self-control when he stayed calm.
words.ex_cn: 当他保持冷静时，他表现出了自制力。
words.en: Self-control is the ability to not show your feelings or not do the things that your feelings make you want to do.

words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.ex: She often refers to her boss as 'the big cheese'.
words.ex_cn: 她经常称她的老板为“大人物”。
words.en: To call someone by a particular name or title.

words.ex: She often refers to her husband as 'the boss'.
words.ex_cn: 她经常把她丈夫称为“老板”。
words.en: To call or describe something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: He is clumsy and dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他很笨拙，把玻璃杯打翻了。
words.en: A clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；接入；汲取（资源、能量、信息等）
words.ex: He taps into his savings to pay for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他动用储蓄来支付旅行费用。
words.en: To make use of a source of energy, knowledge, etc. that already exists.

words.tr: phrase. 有史以来；空前；历来
words.ex: He is the best player of all time.
words.ex_cn: 他是有史以来最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize that someone or something is the best or most important of their kind in history.

words.tr: phrase. 先天性足部畸形，俗称马蹄内翻足
words.ex: He was born with a club foot.
words.ex_cn: 他出生时患有畸形足。
words.en: A congenital deformity of the foot, characterized by a twisted position of the ankle, heel, and toes.

words.ex: The child was born with a severe case of clubfoot.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子出生时患有严重的畸形足。
words.en: A clubfoot is a congenital deformity of one or both feet.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with tuberculosis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有结核病。
words.en: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body.

words.ex: The old man has a hunchback from years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因多年辛勤劳动而驼背。
words.en: A hunchback is a person who has a back that is bent forward, often because of a medical condition.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.tr: 获得荣誉学位：在美国，学生获得的学位证书，表明该学生完成了非常高水平的学业工作。
words.ex: She graduated with honors in mathematics.
words.ex_cn: 她以优异成绩毕业，主修数学。
words.en: To complete a course of study with a level of achievement that is higher than average, often recognized by a special designation or award.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以优异成绩毕业；荣誉毕业
words.ex: He will graduate with honors this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天将以优异成绩毕业。
words.en: To complete a course of study at a college or university with a high level of achievement.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住……的喉咙；比喻义：果断掌控或强力处理某事
words.ex: He took the problem by the throat and solved it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住了问题的关键并迅速解决了它。
words.en: To confront or attack someone or something directly and aggressively.

words.tr: phrase. 找借口；编造理由；为…辩解
words.ex: He made an excuse to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口早早离开。
words.en: To provide a reason or explanation for not doing something or for a mistake.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使某人兴奋或充满干劲；激励某人
words.ex: The coach's inspiring speech really fired the team up.
words.ex_cn: 教练鼓舞人心的演讲真的让队员们兴奋起来了。
words.en: To make someone feel very excited or enthusiastic about something.

words.ex: It is uncommon to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不常见的。
words.en: If you describe something as uncommon, you mean that it does not happen often or is not often seen.

words.ex: He showed decency by helping the old man.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助那位老人，表现出了礼貌和善良。
words.en: Decency is behaviour that is considered to be polite, moral, and acceptable.

words.tr: adv. 仁慈地；（不幸中）幸运地；宽大地
words.ex: Mercifully, the rain stopped before the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，野餐前雨停了。
words.en: In a way that shows mercy or compassion.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.ex: I went to the park with my buddy.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的同伴去了公园。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.tr: 不在乎；毫不关心：表示对某事或某人完全不关心，不在意。
words.ex: He did not give a damn about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他根本不在乎那些规则。
words.en: To not care at all about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 毫不在乎；完全不关心
words.ex: He does not care a damn about what they say.
words.ex_cn: 他根本不在乎他们说什么。
words.en: To not care at all; to be completely indifferent.

words.w: not give a damn about sb.
words.tr: phrase. 对某人毫不在乎；完全不把某人放在心上
words.uk: nɒt ɡɪv ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmbɒdi
words.us: nɑːt ɡɪv ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmbɑːdi
words.ex: He doesn't give a damn about what others think.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不在意别人怎么想。
words.en: To not care at all about someone or something.

words.w: not care a damn about sb.
words.tr: phrase. 对某人毫不在乎；完全不在乎某人
words.uk: nɒt keə(r) ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmbɒdi
words.us: nɑːt ker ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmbɑːdi
words.ex: He doesn't care a damn about what others think.
words.ex_cn: 他对别人的看法毫不在乎。
words.en: To not care at all about someone or something.

words.w: not give a damn about sth.
words.tr: phrase. 对某事毫不在乎；对某事完全不关心
words.uk: nɒt ɡɪv ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: nɑːt ɡɪv ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He doesn't give a damn about what people think of him.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不在乎别人怎么看他。
words.en: To not care at all about something.

words.w: not care a damn about sth.
words.tr: phrase. 对某事毫不在乎；对某事完全不关心
words.uk: nɒt keər ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: nɑːt ker ə dæm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He doesn't care a damn about what others think.
words.ex_cn: 他对别人怎么想毫不在乎。
words.en: To not care at all about something.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr: adj. 多虱的；可鄙的；差劲的
words.ex: The dog had a lousy coat full of fleas.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的毛发多虱子。
words.en: If you describe something as lousy, you mean that it is of very bad quality or that you do not like it.

words.tr: phrase. （粗俗用语）混蛋；可恶的家伙
words.ex: He's such a son of a bitch for leaving without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他连再见都不说就走了，真是个浑蛋。
words.en: A son of a bitch is a very unpleasant or despicable person, often used as an insult.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
n. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
words.ex: He mutters under his breath when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 当他生气时，他会低声嘟囔。
words.en: To speak or say something in a low voice that is hard to hear, often because you are annoyed or complaining.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.ex: The irritation on his arm hurt when he touched it.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的疼痛处一碰就疼。
words.en: Irritation is the feeling of annoyance, especially when something keeps happening that you do not like.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.ex: His upbringing taught him to be honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的抚育让他学会了诚实和善良。
words.en: The way that a child is cared for and taught how to behave while it is growing up.

words.tr: phrase. 正在考虑；正被谈论的；讨论中的；可怀疑
words.ex: The job in question is still available.
words.ex_cn: 正在讨论的工作仍然空缺。
words.en: The person, thing, or group that is in question is the one that you have been talking about or that is involved in the situation you are discussing.

words.tr: adj. 关怀的；切望的；惦记的；悬虑的
words.ex: He was solicitous about her health.
words.ex_cn: 他非常关心她的健康。
words.en: If you are solicitous, you are very concerned about someone's safety, health, or comfort.

words.ex: He gave a contemptuous smile when she spoke.
words.ex_cn: 当她说话时，他露出轻蔑的微笑。
words.en: If you are contemptuous of someone or something, you do not like or respect them at all.

words.ex: He spoke disrespectfully to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他不尊重地对老师说话。
words.en: In a manner that shows a lack of respect.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.ex: The teacher gave him an admonition for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他迟到而给了他一个警告。
words.en: An admonition is a warning or a piece of advice that is given to someone to correct their behavior or to prevent them from doing something wrong.

words.ex: He used a cliche to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个陈词滥调来形容日落。
words.en: A cliché is an idea or phrase that has been used so much that it is no longer interesting or effective.

words.tr:
n. 回想
v. 回想
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回顾过去，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾起来；事后看来；回想当初
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回想起来，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr: adj. 热烈的；强烈的；热情的
words.ex: He is a fervent supporter of environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 他是环境保护的热心支持者。
words.en: having or showing very strong and sincere feelings about something

words.ex: His conviction that honesty is important never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信诚实很重要，从未改变。
words.en: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion, or the state of being found guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: The hustle of the market filled the morning air.
words.ex_cn: 市场的熙攘充满了清晨的空气。
words.en: If you hustle, you work hard to do something quickly, especially in order to earn money.

words.tr: adj. 不适当的；不正当的；不成体统的
words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is improper.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去开会是不适当的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as improper, you mean that it is rude or shocking.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his team.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的团队发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: The club has an affiliation with the university.
words.ex_cn: 这个俱乐部与大学有从属关系。
words.en: An affiliation is a close connection or association with a particular group, organization, or institution.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr: adv. 条件反射式地；另一方面
words.ex: She smiled reflexively when she heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 当听到好消息时，她下意识地笑了。
words.en: In a reflexive manner; done as a reflex without conscious thought.

words.ex: The salesclerk helped the customer find the right size.
words.ex_cn: 售货员帮助顾客找到了合适的尺码。
words.en: A salesclerk is a person whose job is to serve customers in a store.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；无可非议地；
words.ex: He is unquestionably the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Without any doubt; certainly.

words.ex: He is wanting a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一辆新自行车。
words.en: If something is wanting, it is lacking or not good enough in a particular way.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: There is little intercourse between the two villages.
words.ex_cn: 这两个村庄之间很少交往。
words.en: Intercourse refers to communication or dealings between individuals or groups, or sexual activity between people.

words.ex: The police enforce the law.
words.ex_cn: 警察强制执行法律。
words.en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.tr:
v. 同意；赞成
n. 同意；赞成
words.ex: He gave his assent to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他同意了这个计划。
words.en: If you assent to something, you agree to it or agree with it.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.tr: n. 输送；运输；财产让与；运输工具
words.ex: The conveyance of goods took three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输花了三天时间。
words.en: The act or process of transporting or carrying something from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 站着看的人，（公共汽车上的）站客; 站立的乘客
words.ex: The theater had a large number of standees during the premiere.
words.ex_cn: 首映期间，剧院里站着看的人很多。
words.en: A standee is a person who stands, especially in a public place or event because there are no seats available.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.tr: phrase. 设计师牛仔裤；名牌设计师设计的牛仔裤
words.ex: He wears designer jeans to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿名牌牛仔裤去参加派对。
words.en: Designer jeans are jeans that have been designed by a well-known fashion designer or brand, often characterized by their high quality, unique design, and higher price.

words.tr: adv. 茫然地；毫无表情地
words.ex: She stared blankly at the wall, lost in thought.
words.ex_cn: 她茫然地盯着墙，陷入了沉思。
words.en: If you look at someone blankly, you look at them without showing any recognition or understanding.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.tr: adj. 令人烦恼的；令人不安的；令人担忧的
words.ex: The dark clouds look worrisome.
words.ex_cn: 乌云看起来令人担忧。
words.en: If you describe something as worrisome, you mean that it causes you to feel anxious or concerned.

words.tr: n. 聚精会神，热衷，专心致致
words.ex: Her self-absorption made it difficult for her to notice the needs of others.
words.ex_cn: 她的聚精会神使她难以注意到他人的需求。
words.en: The state of being preoccupied with one's own thoughts, feelings, and experiences to the exclusion of others.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: His generosity helped the poor family.
words.ex_cn: 他的慷慨帮助了那个贫困的家庭。
words.en: Generosity is the quality of being kind and generous.

words.ex: Historically, people used abacus for counting.
words.ex_cn: 历史上，人们用算盘进行计算。
words.en: In a way that relates to the study of past events.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物描述为……；把……定性为……
words.ex: The report characterizes the situation as critical.
words.ex_cn: 报告将局势描述为危急。
words.en: To describe or portray the qualities or peculiarities of someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物描述为具有某种特征；把……定义为……
words.ex: They characterize the rule as being unfair.
words.ex_cn: 他们把这条规则描述为不公平的。
words.en: To describe or represent something as having a particular quality or nature.

words.ex: She showed compassion for the homeless man.
words.ex_cn: 她对那个无家可归的人表示同情。
words.en: Compassion is a feeling of pity, sympathy, and understanding for someone who is suffering.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: adj. 弱势的；下层社会的；贫困的
words.ex: The school helps underprivileged children learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助弱势儿童学习阅读。
words.en: People who are underprivileged lack the advantages that other people have, such as enough money or a good standard of living.

words.tr: n. 防御者；防守队员；拥护者；卫冕者
words.ex: The defender stopped the ball with his foot.
words.ex_cn: 防守球员用脚挡住了球。
words.en: A defender is someone who defends a place or person, or who supports an idea or policy.

words.ex: The warmth of the sun made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的温暖让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality, state, or sensation of being warm; moderate and comfortable heat.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.ex: The temple was built in AD 300.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙建于公元300年。
words.en: An ad is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.ex: He is tapping his pen incessantly.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地敲打钢笔。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.ex: The soldiers were bombarded with cannon fire.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们遭到炮火轰击。
words.en: To bombard someone or something means to attack them continuously with bombs, shells, or other missiles. It can also mean to subject someone to a lot of something, such as questions or information.

words.tr: n. 陈词滥调；老生常谈；
words.ex: His speech was full of platitudes about hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲充满了关于努力工作的陈词滥调。
words.en: A platitude is a statement that has been used so often that it is meaningless and shows a lack of original thought.

words.tr: adj. 严厉的；严峻的；冷酷无情的；坚定的；可怕的
words.ex: He had a grim look on his face.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上带着严峻的表情。
words.en: If a situation or piece of news is grim, it is very serious, unpleasant, and depressing.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；无法估计的
words.ex: Her kindness is inestimable.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良是无法估量的。
words.en: If you describe the value, benefit, or importance of something as inestimable, you mean that it is extremely great and cannot be calculated.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.tr:
adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的
v. （使）厌倦；厌烦
words.ex: He looked weary after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后看起来很疲惫。
words.en: If you are weary, you are very tired.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr: phrase. 传动轴；驱动轴（用于传递发动机动力至车轮或其他机械部件的轴）
words.ex: The mechanic inspected the drive shaft for any signs of wear.
words.ex_cn: 机械师检查了传动轴是否有磨损的迹象。
words.en: A drive shaft is a mechanical component for transmitting torque and rotation, usually used to connect other components of a drive train that cannot be connected directly because of distance or the need to allow for relative movement between them.

words.ex: His room is untidy.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很凌乱。
words.en: If you describe something as untidy, you mean that it is not neat or well arranged.

words.ex: They had a bumper harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年他们获得了异常大的收成。
words.en: A bumper is a bar at the front and back of a vehicle that reduces damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车保险杠贴纸；车贴（通常用于表达观点、幽默或宣传）
words.ex: The car had a variety of political bumper stickers on its rear bumper.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的后保险杠上有各种各样的政治保险杠贴纸。
words.en: A bumper sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a message or picture on it, which people stick on the bumper of their car.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: n. 废物堆积场；垃圾场
words.ex: The old car was left to rust in the junkyard.
words.ex_cn: 那辆旧车被丢弃在废车场里生锈。
words.en: A junkyard is a place where old or discarded things, especially metal objects, are collected and often broken up so that the metal can be reused.

words.ex: He bought a new auto last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一辆新车。
words.en: A car; something that operates automatically.

words.tr: n. 墓地；坟场；垃圾场；废物堆积处
words.ex: The old graveyard is quiet at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地晚上很安静。
words.en: A graveyard is an area of land, often near a church, where dead people are buried.

words.tr:
n. 犁沟；车辙；皱纹
v. 犁耕；使皱眉头
words.ex: The farmer plowed a deep furrow in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里犁出了一条深深的犁沟。
words.en: A furrow is a long narrow trench made in the ground by a plow, especially for planting seeds or for irrigation. It can also refer to a deep wrinkle on a person's face.

words.ex: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The brow refers to the eyebrow or the forehead, and can also denote the top edge of a steep place such as a cliff.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: Do you want to go out tonight? Nope.
words.ex_cn: 你今晚想出去吗？不。
words.en: Used to give a negative response or to refuse something.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.tr:
v. 鼓掌；拍手
n. 鼓掌；拍手
words.ex: The crowd will clap after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众会鼓掌。
words.en: To clap means to strike the palms of your hands together to show appreciation or to make a noise.

words.ex: The coffee had a strong bitterness.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有很重的苦味。
words.en: Bitterness is the quality of having a sharp, pungent taste or of feeling angry and unhappy because of bad experiences.

words.ex: He had a run-in with his boss this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上和老板发生了争执。
words.en: A run-in is a disagreement or argument, especially one that happens suddenly.
